project_type: Next.js 16 App Router SPA - air cargo operations dashboard
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm lint to check for TypeScript/ESLint errors. 2. Run pnpm build to confirm Next.js compiles without errors. Since database is needed for runtime but not build, lint+build are the primary validation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/schema.prisma is generated from schema.template.prisma via scripts/sync-prisma-schema.mjs. Run pnpm prisma:sync-schema to regenerate.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/skyhub-cargo-ops. 2. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. 3. Create .env.local with DATABASE_PROVIDER, DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED, SESSION_SECRET. 4. pnpm prisma:generate. 5. pnpm dev.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node.js v22 via nvm. pnpm available. Database requires Neon PostgreSQL - env vars need to be set for runtime but build works without runtime DB connection.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: CSS custom properties for theming, Tailwind 4 utility classes, ops-ui shared components, globals.css for custom class definitions.
key_patterns: 1. All pages use page-workspace layout class. 2. CSS custom properties for colors (--brand-primary, --panel-bg, --border-soft, etc.). 3. Dark/light theme via .dark class on html element. 4. AppShell provides sidebar + topbar with theme toggle in topbar. 5. Settings page also has theme controls. 6. OpsPanel, StatCard, DataCard, FilterBar, EmptyState are shared UI primitives. 7. responsive breakpoints: xl (1280px), lg (1024px), md (768px), sm (640px). 8. Shell content area uses h-svh and flex layout to fit viewport.
directory_structure: src/app/(app)/ = authenticated app pages, src/app/(auth)/ = login/about pages, src/app/api/ = API routes, src/components/ = shared UI, src/lib/ = utilities/auth/data, prisma/ = schema/migrations/seed, scripts/ = build helpers, public/ = static assets
